title: fix(core, plugin-grid): show the handler's userMessage on the failure toast and a per-record failed row
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9QFbRAqaRvPXTXmMiUcMH6T)_

Fixes #34215

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：单条记录动作失败时，提示条先用动作作者写的 `errorMessage`，没有就用处理器写给用户的 `userMessage`，再没有才用平台报错原文。逐条执行的批量动作（`bulkActions: ['NAME']`）结果框里，失败那一行也显示 `userMessage`；下载的错误 CSV 仍保留整句平台报错，便于排查。
- **为什么改**：处理器明明写了给用户看的话（如「商机 B 已赢单，未改阶段」），单条失败提示和批量逐行结果却只显示内部报错句子。整体执行（aggregate）那一半已由 #34213 修好，这是剩下的两处。
- **风险与回滚**：只改失败时显示哪段文字；声明了 `errorMessage` 的动作显示不变，没有 `userMessage` 的拒绝显示不变。`BulkRowError` 多一个可选字段 `userMessage`。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts`（失败提示的取字顺序）；`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/hooks/useBulkExecutor.ts`（逐行拒绝带上 `userMessage`）；`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/components/BulkActionDialog.tsx`（行显示 `userMessage`，CSV 仍写整句）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/core/src/actions/__tests__/ActionRunner.test.ts packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/objectBulkActionDispatch.test.tsx -t 34215`，预期 7 条全绿。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **Failure toast** (`ActionRunner`, `@object-ui/core`): the message is the action's authored `errorMessage`, else the refusal's producer-marked `ActionResult.userMessage`, else `result.error` (seat ruling on the card's delta: authored first, because the spec declares `errorMessage` the override of the raw error). A blank `userMessage` is no marking, the same non-empty rule `declaredUserMessage` and `@objectstack/client` apply; the existing non-string coercion is unchanged.
- **Per-record bulk run** (`@object-ui/plugin-grid`):
  - `ObjectGrid`'s per-record runner (`runBulkActionRecord`) attaches the refusal's `userMessage` to the rejection, as the aggregate runner below it already does.
  - `useBulkExecutor` reads `declaredUserMessage` off each per-record rejection of the custom runner and sets it on that row as a new optional `BulkRowError.userMessage`; `error` stays the whole text. The shared `executeBulkBatch` (`bulkFastPath.ts`) is untouched.
  - `BulkActionDialog` lists `userMessage` for the row when present, else `error`; the error CSV still writes `error`.
- **Docs** (surface amended by the seat on the card): `content/docs/ui/actions.mdx` states the toast's order; `content/docs/ui/views.mdx` states what a per-record run's row and error CSV show.
- Changeset `.changeset/34215-failure-toast-row-user-message.md` (patch: `@object-ui/core`, `@object-ui/plugin-grid`).

## Why

A handler that refuses with a `userMessage` wrote that sentence for the end user. #34213 carried it to `ActionResult.userMessage` and showed it on the aggregate outcome; the single-record toast and the per-record failed row still showed the platform text.

## Tests

New block in `ui/packages/core/src/actions/__tests__/ActionRunner.test.ts`, "the failure toast shows the refusal's userMessage (objectstack#34215)":
- shows the `userMessage` of a refusal that carries one;
- carries it from the `/actions` door: a real `createServerActionHandler` over a refusal envelope reaches the toast;
- CONTROL: a refusal without a `userMessage` keeps the error;
- a blank `userMessage` is no marking;
- an authored `errorMessage` keeps its text even when the refusal carries a `userMessage`.

New block in `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/objectBulkActionDispatch.test.tsx`, "a per-record failed row shows the refusal's userMessage (objectstack#34215)", driving the real `ObjectGrid` through `createServerActionHandler`:
- the row lists `userMessage` (not the platform text), and the downloaded error CSV's row keeps the platform text (not the `userMessage`);
- CONTROL: a refusal without a `userMessage` keeps the platform text on the row.

**Declared forced test edit:** the #34213 CONTROL "a per-record dispatch with one failing row still lists that row" asserted `PLATFORM_TEXT` on `bulk-error-row-r2` for a refusal carrying `userMessage`; it now asserts `USER_TEXT`, which is the behaviour this card asks for. Its comment says so.

Run through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` under the verify lock, `-t 34215`, on head e19178cd (before the main merge; the merge touched none of these files):

| A7 | dialog row reads `e.error` | row pin |
| A8 | CSV writes `e.userMessage ?? e.error` | row pin, at the CSV assertion (the CSV row lost the platform text) |

ui tests resolve `@object-ui/*` from `src`, so no dist leg applies.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The per-record `userMessage` read is scoped to the promoted custom runner (the card's surface). A data-door `update`/`delete` row whose rejection carried a `userMessage` still shows its message; no producer of that shape was measured, so it is noted here, not filed.
